requirement.statement: .NET OM SHALL expose additive strict-by-default V2 migration and rollback APIs which preflight before mutation, return structured diagnostics/results, and apply schema, snapshot, state and history changes atomically.

case.given: a migration or rollback contains an invalid strict operation
case.then: it SHALL return or throw structured failure without partially changing schema state, data, snapshots or migration history

requirement.statement: .NET OM SHALL detect legacy non-temporal relation shapes without automatic mutation by default, provide explicit idempotent upgrade, preserve compatibility wrappers, and return deterministic keyed diffs over the full C# snapshot including behavior metadata.

case.given: a database contains a supported legacy relation shape
case.then: it SHALL report detect-only status and SHALL change storage only after an explicit upgrade request or opt-in
